0.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000
0.description: Ahhh, 'tis a fine day to be watching my pugilists at their training!

5.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_010
5.description: <gasp> You mean to say you do not know Hamon Holyfist, the man who once ruled the bloodsands!?<hex:02100103>...Hmmm, mayhap it was before your time.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_011
6.description: Aye, I used to be champion of the Coliseum, but these days I train young hopefuls as master of the Pugilists' Guild. If you're interested in learning hand-to-hand combat, you're welcome to sign up.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_012
7.description: And if you're a scantily clad maiden, then you're <hex:021A020203>especially<hex:021A020103> welcome! Hah hah hah!

8.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_020
8.description: A pugilist is an expert in hand-to-hand combat. Through rigorous training, he forges devastating weapons of his limbs.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_021
9.description: Having said that, fists and feet don't deal near as much damage as a blade. But what does that matter when you can land several blows for each swing of the sword?

10.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_022
10.description: Aye, what a pugilist lacks in destructive force, he makes up for in speed and cunning. Rather than trying to deal great damage with a single blow, he pummels his foe with lightning-fast combinations.

11.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_023
11.description: If you become as good as yours truly, your combinations will be so swift and seamless, folk won't be able to tell when one technique ends and another begins! Hah hah hah!

12.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_050
12.description: Oho, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Ever a sight for these old eyes!

13.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_060
13.description: Ah, if it isn't my dear <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Professor Erik the Long<hex:021F0103>winded tells me you've made a monk of yourself, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>.

14.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_061
14.description: You were ever one of my most inquisitive, so the news hardly came as a surprise. Needless to say I'm very proud of you! We ought to go at it a few rounds again, just like the good old days, eh?

15.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_070
15.description: Ah, my dear <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Rumor has it you've gotten dragged into some unsavory business. But keep your chin up, you hear? I believe in your innocence─we all do. And those that believe otherwise will have to answer to my fists of fury! Hah hah hah!

16.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_071
16.description: Ah, my dear <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The unsavory business has been settled, so I'm told. While I'm happy for you, I was rather looking forward to knocking some villains around... Well, maybe the next time you get framed, eh? Hah hah hah!

21.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_100
21.description: We've been getting a lot of young blood joining the guild of late. It's all I can do to remember their names.

22.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_101
22.description: Considering the fine job she did training you, I decided to place Chuchuto in charge of all the new recruits. As an added bonus, I've freed myself to chase after scantily clad maidens!

23.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_102
23.description: Having said that, I must confess I haven't had any success in that arena. With my youthful vigor reclaimed, I thought that I was certain to be popular with the ladies again. Ahhh, I can't imagine what I'm doing wrong.

24.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_120
24.description: Oh, there isn't much to report on my end, but it seems you've been busy making light work of the impossible. Truly, I trained you well, hah hah hah!<hex:02100103>...Now then, you did as I requested, I trust?

25.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_121
25.description: What request? Why, the one I wrote on a letter for Chuchuto to pass to you, of course! While you were in Garlemald, you were to sing my praises to beautiful maidens.

26.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_122
26.description: ...What? Why are you looking at me like that?

27.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_110
27.description: And here I thought <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> was the one having trouble remembering things! Well, young'un, allow me refresh your memory─it'll serve to refresh mine as well, hah hah hah!

28.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_111
28.description: A pugilist is an expert in hand-to-hand combat. Through rigorous training, he forges devastating weapons of his limbs. Having said that, fists and feet don't deal near as much damage as a blade. But what does that matter when you can land several blows for each swing of the sword?

29.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_112
29.description: Aye, what a pugilist lacks in destructive force, he makes up for in speed and cunning. Rather than trying to deal great damage with a single blow, he pummels his foe with lightning-fast combinations.

30.name: TEXT_REGWILPGLGUILD_00064_HAMON_000_113
30.description: As an expert like yourself can attest, our combinations are so swift and seamless, folk can't tell when one technique ends and another begins! Hah hah hah!
